findings.standard: An Instar Agent Is Always a Multi-Machine Entity
findings.reason: The owner view can report loss debt only for items it knows about, but the design provides no way to show the required unknown range when the creator disappears before any surviving machine learns which items it held.

findings.standard: An Instar Agent Always Serves a Team
findings.reason: The blanket exclusion of team-role readers from placement metadata covers even a member who owns the child and can read its parent, denying that owner the feature without a stated reason.

The stated outcome requires generated chats to stop appearing as unrelated roots in the native App, yet the client only “may” use the new display state, so the proposed server changes can succeed while the real user journey still fails.
